# trade-valuation: Trade valuation (from CSV)

*Generated by `tools/mrloader/kind_docs.py` from the kind's contract, its mapping file and its sample: do not edit; change the mapping or the contract and run it again.*

## 1. What it is and who reads it

Each trade's valuation of the day from the risk engine: its netting set, counterparty, book, status, notional and MtM.

A trade's valuation from the risk engine, for every source system: MTM, one-day P&L and DV01, with what it values (source system, portfolio, desk, product).

- **Contract:** `modules/banking/packs/market-risk/contracts/trade-valuation.contract.yaml` (pack `market-risk`, class `fundamental`), key `VALUATION_ID`.
- **Mapping:** `tools/mrloader/kinds/trade-valuation.yaml` (source `canonical`); wave 2 of the CSV loaders.
- **Grain:** One row per trade valuation per business date, keyed by VALUATION_ID.

## 2. The command

```bash
python3 tools/mrloader/csv_load.py --kind trade-valuation --csv FILE --date YYYY-MM-DD --dry-run   # check; write nothing
python3 tools/mrloader/csv_load.py --kind trade-valuation --csv FILE --date YYYY-MM-DD --inbox     # convert and hand to the data inbox
python3 tools/mrloader/csv_load.py --kind trade-valuation --template                                       # the header and an example row
```

In a day file: `trade-valuation: {csv: "FILE"}`. A bank's own column names: a mapping file of its own, given with `--mapping FILE`.

## 3. The CSV, column by column

The file's format: delimiter `,`, encoding `utf-8`, decimal `.`, thousands `,`, dates `YYYY-MM-DD` (declared in the mapping's `csv:` block over `kinds/shared/csv.yaml`; never guessed). Column names compare upper-cased, other characters as `_`.

| Column | Required | Field | Rule | Description | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TRADE_ID` | yes | `TRADE_ID` | text, kept as written | The trade valued: a TRADE_ID of the trading pack's trade kind, as text (ENDUR digits, CLY-…, MX-…). | as the source system writes it: text |
| `VALUATION_ID` | no | `VALUATION_ID` | empty: `TVAL-{@TRADE_ID}`; text, kept as written | The record's id (the business key) |  |
| `SOURCE_SYSTEM` | yes | `SOURCE_SYSTEM` | upper-cased | The trade's booking system: ENDUR, CALYPSO or MUREX. |  |
| `PRODUCT_TYPE` | yes | `PRODUCT_TYPE` | as written | The trade's product type as booked (ComSwap, IRS_FIXFLOAT …), the trade's PRODUCT_TYPE. |  |
| `PRODUCT_GROUP` | yes | `PRODUCT_GROUP` | as written | The trade's product group (Commodity, Rates, FX, Credit, Equity …). |  |
| `PORTFOLIO` | yes | `PORTFOLIO` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `BOOK-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The book the trade sits in: a BOOK_ID of the core pack's book kind (BOOK-…). |  |
| `DESK` | yes | `DESK` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `DESK-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The desk of the trade's book: a DESK_ID of the core pack's desk kind (DESK-…). |  |
| `COUNTERPARTY` | yes | `COUNTERPARTY` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `CP-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The trade's counterparty: a COUNTERPARTY_ID of the core pack's counterparty kind (CP-…). |  |
| `NETTING_SET` | no | `NETTING_SET` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `NS-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The netting set the trade belongs to: a NETTING_SET_ID of the counterparty-risk pack's netting-set kind (NS-<counterparty>-<legal entity>). | empty: outside every set (stand-alone) |
| `TRADER_ID` | no | `TRADER_ID` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `TRDR-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The trader of the trade: a TRADER_ID of the core pack's trader kind (TRDR-…). The VaR engine's VaR by trader joins it to the P&L vectors by TRADE_ID (contributions by=attribute:TRADER_ID), so it is kept as a column of th |  |
| `BUY_SELL_CODE` | yes | `BUY_SELL_CODE` | upper-cased; mapped: `B` to `B`, `S` to `S`, `BUY` to `B`, `SELL` to `S` | B when the bank bought (or receives), S when it sold. |  |
| `TRADE_STATUS` | yes | `TRADE_STATUS` | upper-cased | The trade's status on the valuation date: NEW, VALIDATED, AMENDED, MATURED or CANCELLED; a trade that ends keeps a row on that date with its last value. | NEW, VALIDATED, AMENDED, CANCELLED, MATURED |
| `CURRENCY` | yes | `CURRENCY` | upper-cased | The trade's own currency, ISO 4217 (MTM is in USD whatever it is). |  |
| `NOTIONAL` | yes | `NOTIONAL` | a number (decimal `.`) | The trade's current notional in USD, absolute (the first leg's). |  |
| `MTM` | yes | `MTM` | a number (decimal `.`) | The trade's mark-to-market on the valuation date in USD, dirty (accrued included); positive is an asset of the bank. | signed: positive when the counterparty owes the bank |
| `MTM_CURRENCY` | no | `MTM_CURRENCY` | upper-cased; empty: `USD` | The currency MTM, PNL_1D and DV01 are reported in (USD in the demo). |  |
| `PNL_1D` | no | `PNL_1D` | a number (decimal `.`) | The valuation engine's own one-day P&L of the trade in USD, gain positive. |  |
| `DV01` | no | `DV01` | a number (decimal `.`) | The change of MTM in USD for a +1 bp parallel shift of every rate curve (a receiver swap's is positive); 0 when the trade has no rate risk. |  |
| `TRADE_DATE` | yes | `TRADE_DATE` | a date (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYYMMDD) | The date the trade was dealt (YYYY-MM-DD). |  |
| `MATURITY_DATE` | yes | `MATURITY_DATE` | a date (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYYMMDD) | The trade's maturity date. |  |
| `VALUATION_DATE` | no | `VALUATION_DATE` | empty: `{$business_date}`; a date (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYYMMDD) | The date the trade is valued on: the business date of the file. |  |

## 5. What is not loaded

Nothing: every field the CSV gives is loaded.

## 6. Checks

- **A rejected row:** `on-reject: skip`, `max-rejects: 1%` (rejected rows are listed and the rest loads). A duplicate key always refuses it.
- **Unique:** `VALUATION_ID`, `TRADE_ID` per business date.
- **Link** `PORTFOLIO` to `book`: policy `warn` (mr_run.py checks it against the day's `book` file, else `--against`; a target found nowhere is *not checked*).
- **Link** `DESK` to `desk`: policy `warn` (mr_run.py checks it against the day's `desk` file, else `--against`; a target found nowhere is *not checked*).
- **Link** `COUNTERPARTY` to `counterparty`: policy `warn` (mr_run.py checks it against the day's `counterparty` file, else `--against`; a target found nowhere is *not checked*).
- **Link** `NETTING_SET` to `netting-set`: policy `refuse` (mr_run.py checks it against the day's `netting-set` file, else `--against`; a target found nowhere is *not checked*).

Reject codes it can give: `MISSING_REQUIRED`, `BAD_DATE`, `BAD_NUMBER`, `EXCEL_NUMBER_ID`, `BAD_ENUM`, `BAD_PATTERN`, `DUPLICATE_KEY`, `EXCEL_ERROR`, `FORMULA`, `BAD_ROW_SHAPE`.
Each line of `<kind>.<date>.rejects.csv` gives FILE, ROW (as a spreadsheet shows it), KEY, COLUMN, FIELD, VALUE, REASON, WHY, FIX.

## 7. Before and after

- **Load first:** `netting-set`, `book`, `desk`.
- **Then:** nothing depends on it.

## 8. Repeat, restate, remove

- **Again for the same date:** the same command; the date's `trade-valuation` rows are replaced as a whole (`mode: replace`).
- **Restate a past date:** run with that `--date`; to change one row, send the whole file again.
- **Remove the date:** `python3 tools/drishti.py lake delete --lake LAKE --kind trade-valuation --date YYYY-MM-DD --dry-run` (then without `--dry-run`).

## 9. Spreadsheet warnings

- `TRADE_ID`: an id: export the column as text (a long id saved as a number, `2.00001E+11`, is refused; leading zeros lost are not detectable without `pad:`)
- `VALUATION_ID`: an id: export the column as text (a long id saved as a number, `2.00001E+11`, is refused; leading zeros lost are not detectable without `pad:`)
- `PORTFOLIO`: an id: export the column as text (a long id saved as a number, `2.00001E+11`, is refused; leading zeros lost are not detectable without `pad:`)
- `DESK`: an id: export the column as text (a long id saved as a number, `2.00001E+11`, is refused; leading zeros lost are not detectable without `pad:`)
- `COUNTERPARTY`: an id: export the column as text (a long id saved as a number, `2.00001E+11`, is refused; leading zeros lost are not detectable without `pad:`)
- `NETTING_SET`: an id: export the column as text (a long id saved as a number, `2.00001E+11`, is refused; leading zeros lost are not detectable without `pad:`)
- `TRADER_ID`: an id: export the column as text (a long id saved as a number, `2.00001E+11`, is refused; leading zeros lost are not detectable without `pad:`)
- `TRADE_DATE`: a date: a spreadsheet may rewrite it to the machine's locale; declare `csv.dates` or export ISO dates
- `MATURITY_DATE`: a date: a spreadsheet may rewrite it to the machine's locale; declare `csv.dates` or export ISO dates
- `VALUATION_DATE`: a date: a spreadsheet may rewrite it to the machine's locale; declare `csv.dates` or export ISO dates

## 10. Source variants

None shipped. A source with other column names gets a mapping file `kinds/trade-valuation.<source>.yaml` (or a site's own, by `--mapping`).
